doctrine: Maximize verified scientific information while minimizing persistent physical and computational structure.
rebuild: Restore source_files, run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_omega_sensorium.py' -v, then run python -m omega_sensorium.cli.
falsifiers: If an existing repository primitive expresses a Sensorium primitive without loss, merge rather than retain duplication.
If a simpler capability search preserves the same frozen tests and decisions, prefer the simpler implementation.
Simulation outputs cannot promote astrophysical or hardware claims beyond their evidence class.
negative_space: No claim that generated detector designs are physically realizable
